description: Health check for .aide spec files in the project. Detects orphaned specs (a spec whose folder, subfolders included, holds no code — only AIDE files, Markdown and dot-files; the project root intent spec in .aide/ is never orphaned, and a plan's presence never decides it), plans with no intent spec beside them (plan-without-spec — write the folder's spec, never delete the plan), missing specs (orchestrators with 3+ helper imports but no .aide), naming conflicts (.aide + intent.aide in same folder), broken links, orphaned research (research.aide without intent spec), missing descriptions (specs with no description field in frontmatter), files whose frontmatter cannot be parsed, and intent specs whose alignment is missing (missing-alignment) or not one of unreviewed, aligned, misaligned (invalid-alignment).

path.description: Subdirectory to validate (defaults to entire project)

name: aide_validate
